dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the research of positive displacement reversible pump turbine cfd validation

description: NTNU provides a CFD setup for a reversible lobe pump-turbine studied for low-head pumped-hydro storage. ANSYS CFX and TwinMesh are the stated solver and mesh-generation dependencies. The source describes reference CAD and boundary conditions in accompanying thesis documentation. It links the setup to ALPHEUS deliverable 2.5 experimental measurements and includes exported velocity-field CSV results and MATLAB post-processing. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The full deformable mesh is described as too large to include and must be generated with TwinMesh. The model bundle is distinct from the PIV experiment. Dependencies, mesh creation, thesis documentation and numerical agreement were not tested. The setup enables CFD simulation against the related experimental observations.
inputs: Reference CAD, case boundary conditions and deformable meshes generated with TwinMesh.
name: Data underlying the research of Positive Displacement Reversible Pump-Turbine - CFD Validation
notes: Metadata only. No linked files, executable source, dataset arrays, archives, images, instruction documents or external API data were acquired. Native source claims were not independently reproduced.
outputs: Flow rate, pressure and horizontal/vertical velocity fields.

sources.note: Native identity, full descriptive text, terms and selected custom fields reviewed.
